rivals.name: largest_multicolor_group
rivals.meaning: Ignore the header; choose the largest multicolor four-connected nonzero body group, then crop the original-grid bbox of its largest monochrome component and scale by 2.
rivals.program:
(rule! (let ((dummy 0))

(define (review-list< a b)
  (cond ((empty? a) #f)
        ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
        ((> (first a) (first b)) #f)
        (else (review-list< (rest a) (rest b)))))
(define (review-larger a b)
  (if (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
      (review-list< (obj-bbox a) (obj-bbox b))
      (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))
(define (review-crop work target)
  (let ((bb (obj-bbox target)))
    (upscale (subgrid work (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)) 2)))

  (let* ((work (subgrid g 1 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
         (mono (objects work 0))
         (binary (map (lambda (row)
                        (map (lambda (v) (if (= v 0) 0 1)) row)) work))
         (mixed (filter
                   (lambda (obj)
                     (> (length (remove-duplicates
                          (map (lambda (p) (at work (first p) (second p)))
                               (obj-cells obj)))) 1))
                   (objects binary 0))))
    (if (empty? mixed)
        '((0))
        (let* ((group (first (sort mixed review-larger)))
               (inside (filter
                         (lambda (obj)
                           (all? (lambda (p) (member? p (obj-cells group)))
                                 (obj-cells obj))) mono))
               (target (first (sort inside review-larger))))
          (review-crop work target))))))

rivals.name: area_rank_2
rivals.meaning: Ignore the header; crop the original-grid bbox of the second-largest monochrome body component and scale by 2.
rivals.program:
(rule! (let ((dummy 0))

(define (review-list< a b)
  (cond ((empty? a) #f)
        ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
        ((> (first a) (first b)) #f)

(define (review-larger a b)
  (if (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
      (review-list< (obj-bbox a) (obj-bbox b))
      (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))
(define (review-crop work target)
  (let ((bb (obj-bbox target)))
    (upscale (subgrid work (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)) 2)))
